description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the Goteo Model 'Info'. It contains tests for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting 'Info' objects, and associated image handling logic.

classes.name: InfoTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the functionality of the Goteo Model 'Info', including creation, update, deletion, gallery management, and database integrity.

methods.name: testInstance
methods.description: Tests instantiation of an Info object and confirms it is an instance of Goteo\Model\Info.

methods.name: testValidate
methods.description: Validates the Info object and asserts that validation and save operations return false, indicating incomplete or invalid data.

methods.name: testCreateInfo
methods.description: Creates a new Info object with predefined data, validates and saves it, then returns the object.

methods.name: testGetInfo
methods.description: Retrieves the Info object by ID and asserts that its properties match the expected data.

methods.name: testEditInfo
methods.description: Modifies the Info object, adds images, validates and saves, and checks that the gallery and image associations are correct.

methods.name: testRemoveImageInfo
methods.description: Removes images from Info object gallery, checks proper removal, and tests re-adding images.

methods.name: testDeleteInfo
methods.description: Deletes the Info object from the database and confirms deletion.

methods.name: testCleanProjectRelated
methods.description: Cleans up orphaned entries in related tables to maintain database integrity after deletions.
